title: Police Chief
statement: No public safety event in this cycle's export requires an institutional statement from this office. The district readings show crime indices holding in a tight band across the city — Fruitvale at 0.67 and San Antonio at 0.73 remain the highest, with most neighborhoods flat or down slightly from last cycle. That is a steady picture, not an announcement. I am holding the citywide patrol posture at balanced, keeping OARI co-response coordination in East and West Oakland in place, and watching the districts rather than speaking about them.

payload.note: Crime indices flat to slightly down citywide with no single district deteriorating sharply enough to justify shifting resources; balanced posture maintains even coverage and preserves OARI co-response coordination.
